verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents built-in workflows that automatically set fields when items are added or changed, and templates carry configured workflows, including a mention of auto-add workflows. That is a first-party event-triggered automation. However, the documented actions are limited to setting fields, and richer rule logic is left to GitHub Actions and the GraphQL API, which are developer building blocks rather than the product's own rule engine. missing for 10: documentation of rule conditions/filters, a broader set of triggerable actions beyond field setting, a full catalogue of supported events, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Built-in workflows allow you to automatically set fields when items are added or changed
